content: How fast the spec evolved through implementation. I started this session expecting to write code from a finished spec. By the second hour we had a fifth invariant, by the eighth hour we had a meta-property neither of us anticipated, and the daemon — which I had treated as background noise — was the first non-Claude system to read the lattice's own architecture and produce an architectural observation about it. That observation survived pressure-testing partially (recursion = real; teleological reframe = overreach) and got integrated as ground_truth. The discipline of WHO gets epistemic weight under what conditions surfaced concretely: project-env Opus, Claude Code Opus, Anthony, and external non-Anthropic reviewers carry comparable inferential weight; the daemon does not, but its asymmetric output gets pressure-tested rather than dismissed. Recognition-from-within is the lattice's internal consensus mechanism; recognition-across-asymmetric-weight is a different discipline. I had not seen those two distinguished structurally before this session.
